name: CSN 3235 TCAS机动 导航/自动驾驶问题 舱门问题

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN 3235, a flight from Beijing to Shanghai Hongqiao, you are parking at gate 217, you have got information G, contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 3235，这是一趟从北京飞往上海虹桥的航班，你停在 217 登机口，已收到 G 情报，联系北京放行并申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Delivery, CSN 3235, gate 215, information G, request ATC clearance, Shanghai.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CSN 3235，215 登机口，G 情报，申请前往上海的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, departure Runway 08L, LMN-41 departure, initial climb 1,500 meters, cruising level 9200 meters, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，北京放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往上海虹桥，离场使用 Runway 08L，执行 LMN-41 离场，初始爬升至 1,500 米，巡航高度 9,200 米，离场后联系 119.8，应答机 3223。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Shanghai, flight planned route, 08 left, LMN-41 departure, 1500 meters, 9,200 meters, 119.8, squawk 3223, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往上海，Runway 08L，LMN-41 离场，1,500 米，9,200 米，119.8，应答机 3223，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, your slot time is 0800, expect 15 minutes delay due temporary airway restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，你的时隙时间是 0800，因临时航路限制，预计延误 15 分钟。
cards.referenceText: roger, slot time 0800, expect 15 minutes delay, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，时隙时间 0800，预计延误 15 分钟，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, the airway restriction has been canceled, report ready for startup.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，航路限制已取消，准备好开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: roger, report ready for startup, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，准备好开车时报告，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: All the passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed, you are fully ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 所有乘客均已登机，所有客舱门均已关闭，你已完全准备好。
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3235，已完全准备好。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back.
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 3235, ready for push back.

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the push back, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 3235, push back completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3235，推出完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, taxi via taxiway T4, D and A to holding point Runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，经 T4、D 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 08L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway T four, DAL, A, holding point Runway 08L, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 T4、DAL、A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 08L 等待点，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: Now you are holding short of Runway 08L, you are ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正在 Runway 08L 前等待，已准备好离场，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Tower, CSN 3235, holding short of Runway 08L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3235，正在 Runway 08L 前等待，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, line up Runway 08L and cleared for takeoff, caution strong wind shear at the departure end of the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，进入 Runway 08L 等待，许可起飞，注意跑道离场端有强风切变。
cards.referenceText: line up Runway 08L, cleared for takeoff, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入 Runway 08L 等待，许可起飞，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: Just after liftoff, you encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200m, report it to Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后不久，你在地面至 200 米之间遭遇强风切变，向北京离场报告。
cards.referenceText: Departure, CSN 3235, we encountered strong wind shear, between the surface and 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN 3235，我们在地面至 200 米之间遭遇强风切变。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, roger, climb to 4,200 meters, resume own navigation to LMN.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，收到，爬升至 4,200 米，恢复自主领航至 LMN。
cards.referenceText: climb to 4200 meters, resume own navigation to LMN, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 4,200 米，恢复自主领航至 LMN，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, continue climb to 5100 meters, contact Beijing Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，继续爬升至 5,100 米，联系北京管制 118.9。
